Docs.summary: Provides a bounded, least-recently-used cache of Graphite texture-backed images keyed by source image.

remarks.format:
## Remarks
Use this cache to avoid re-uploading the same <xref:SkiaSharp.SKImage> to the GPU on every frame. Pass <xref:SkiaSharp.SKGraphiteImageCache.FindOrCreate(SkiaSharp.SKGraphiteRecorder,SkiaSharp.SKImage,System.Boolean)> as the find-or-create callback when creating a recorder. This type implements <xref:System.IDisposable>; dispose it while the owning recorder is still alive to release the cached texture references.
